title: Ovqat, ichimlik va kafeda buyurtma berish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida mahsulot nomlarini aytasiz, “men istayman” va “buyurtma qiladiganman” shakllarida kafeda buyurtma berasiz, narhni so‘rayasiz va mahsulot turlarini ajratib aytasiz.

scenes.title: To‘qqizinchi dars: kafeda
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! To‘qqizinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda hozirgi zamon fe’llarini va takrorlanish so‘zlarini o‘rgandik. Bugun kafeda buyurtma berishni o‘rganamiz: ovqat va ichimlik nomlarini, “men istayman” va “buyortma qiladiganman” shakllarini, narhni so‘rashni va to‘lashni. Dars oxirida kafeda buyurtma beruvchi shaxsdan tarjima qilasiz. Boshlaymiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson nine. Today we order food and drinks in a café.
scenes.say_uz: To‘qqizinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun kafeda buyurtma berishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Ichimliklar: birinchi to‘rt
scenes.say_native: Avval ichimliklar. “Qahvah” — qahva, “shāʾ” — choy, “māʾ” — suv, “ʿaṣīr” — sharbat. Bu so‘zlar ayol jinsli emas, erkak jinsli. “Al-qahwah” — o‘sha qahva. Gapda noaniq: “urīdu qahvah” — men qahvamni istayman. “Māʾ” da hamza bor, uni erkin ayting. E’tibor bering: “qahvah” da “h” aniq, oxirgi “-ah” qo‘shimcha oxiri bo‘ladi, lekin yozuvda ta marbuta emas.
scenes.say: Qahva, chai, ma, aseer.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva, choy, suv, sharbat.

scenes.title: Ichimliklar: yana to‘rt
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta. “Ḥalb” — sut, “ʿaṣīr tuffāḥ” — olma sharbati, “kūkūkūlā” — koka-kola, “miyāh” — suvlar. “ʿAṣīr” va ichimlik nomi iḍafa bilan bog‘lanadi: olma sharbati. “Kūkūkūlā” bayt sifatida, gazlagan ichimlik. “Miyāh” — “māʾ”ning ko‘pligi. “Al-miyāh” — suvlar. Ichimliklarni kafeda buyurtma berishda eng ko‘p ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: Halb, aseer tuffah, coca cola, miyah.
scenes.say_uz: Halb, aseer tuffah, coca cola, miyah.

scenes.title: Ichimlikni toping
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta ichimlikni arabcha ayting: qahva, choy, suv, sharbat, sut. Har birini baland ovozda, hamzaga e’tibor bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Say the Arabic words for coffee, tea, water, juice and milk.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: qahva, choy, suv, sharbat, sut.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: qahvah, shāʾ, māʾ, ʿaṣīr, ḥalb. “Shāʾ” va “māʾ” da uzun “ā” bor. “ʿAṣīr” da shadda: ʿaṣ-ṣir. “Ḥalb” da “l” bor, lekin oxiri “b”. Bu ichimliklarni yaxshi yodlab oling, keyingi darda buyurtma berishda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Qahva, chai, water, juice, milk.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva, choy, suv, sharbat, sut.

scenes.title: Ovqatlar: birinchi to‘rt
scenes.say_native: Endi ovqatlar. “Khubz” — non, “jubn” — panir, “bayḍ” — tuxum, “laḥm” — go‘sht. Bu so‘zlar erta nonushtada eng ko‘p ishlatiladi. “Khubz” da “z” so‘ngda eshitiladi. “Jubn” da “b” so‘ngda. “Bayḍ” da hamza bo‘lgan “ḍ” bor. “Laḥm” — go‘sht, “laḥm baqarī” — mantiq go‘shti. O‘zbek tilida “tuxum” erkak va ayolga bir xil, arabchada ham shunday, shuning uchun shaklni o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say: Khubz, jubn, bayd, lahmd. Bread, cheese, eggs, meat.
scenes.say_uz: Khubz, jubn, bayd, lahmd. Non, panir, tuxum, go‘sht.

scenes.title: Ovqatlar: yana to‘rt
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta. “Fākiḥah” — meva, “biṭāṭis” — kartoshka, “sukkar” — shakar, “ʿasal” — bal. “Biṭāṭis” uzun so‘z, bo‘g‘inlarni ajratib ayting: bi-ṭā-ṭis. “Sukkar” da “k” ikkilanadi: suk-kar. “Fākiḥah” ayol jinsli, lekin ma’nosida meva bo‘ladi. “ʿAsal” — bal, qahvaga qo‘shiladi. Bu so‘zlar kafeda buyurtma berishda foydali.
scenes.say: Fakiha, batatis, sukkar, asal.
scenes.say_uz: Fakiha, batatis, sukkar, asal.

scenes.title: Ovqatni toping
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta ovqatni arabcha ayting: non, panir, tuxum, go‘sht, kartoshka. Ikkinchi undoshlar va shaddalarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Say the Arabic words for bread, cheese, eggs, meat and potatoes.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: non, panir, tuxum, go‘sht, kartoshka.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: khubz, jubn, bayḍ, laḥm, biṭāṭis. “Bayḍ” va “laḥm” da “-ḍ” va “-m” oxiri to‘g‘ri talaffuz qilinishi kerak. “Biṭāṭis” da yoxshroq “t” harflari bor. Endi ichimlik va ovqatlarni birga ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: Khubz, jubn, eggs, meat, potatoes.
scenes.say_uz: Khubz, jubn, bayd, lahm, batatis.

scenes.title: “Men istayman” — uḥibbu
scenes.say_native: Buyurtma berishning oddiy usuli “uḥibbu” — men istayman yoki yaxshi ko‘raman. “Uḥibbu al-qahwah” — menga qahva yaxshi. “Uḥibbu ash-shāʾ” — menga choy yaxshi. E’tibor bering: “al-qahwah” da “al” bor, chunki aniq mahsulot. “Uḥibbu māʾ” — menga suv yaxshi. “Uḥibbu” fe’li bilan obyekt majrūr bo‘ladi, ya’ni “-a” bilan: al-qahwata, ash-shāya. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi “-ni” qo‘shimchasiga o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: Uhibbu al-qahwa means I like coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Uhibbu al-qahwa — menga qahva yaxshi.

scenes.title: “Uḥibbu” xatosi
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: obyekt uchun “al” va “-a” bo‘lishi shart: “uḥibbu al-māʾa”, “uḥibbu māʾ” emas. Ikkinchisi: noaniq narsa uchun “-un” emas: “uḥibbu al-qahwata” — aniq qahva, “uḥibbu qahwatan” — bitta qahva. Buyurtma berishda aniq mahsulot ishlatiladi, shuning uchun “al-qahwata” to‘g‘ri. Obyektning oxiriga “-a” qo‘shilishi shart, uni unutmang.
scenes.say: Say uhibbu al-mata, not uhibbu ma. The object takes -a.
scenes.say_uz: Uhibbu al-mata, uhibbu ma emas. Obyekt oxiri -a bilan tugaydi.

scenes.title: Qayerda nima bor?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: qahva bor. Ikkinchi: choy bor. Uchinchi: non bor. To‘rtinchi: shakar bor. “Fī” predlogini yoki iḍafani ishlatsangiz ham bo‘ladi, lekin hozircha oddiy “mawjūd” shaklida aytamiz.
scenes.say: There is coffee. There is tea. There is bread. There is sugar.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva bor. Choy bor. Non bor. Shakar bor.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: fīhā qahvah. Fīhā shāʾ. Fīhā khubz. Fīhā sukkar. “Fīhā” — unda bor. O‘zbek tilida “bor” alohida so‘z, arabchada “fīhā” yoki “fīh” bunday ma’noda ishlatiladi. Endi buyurtma beruvchi fe’llarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: There is coffee. There is tea. There is bread. There is sugar.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva bor. Choy bor. Non bor. Shakar bor.

scenes.title: Buyurtma beruvchi fe’llar
board: أُحِبُّ شَرْبَةً مِنَ الْقَهْوَةِ — bir cherek qahva
scenes.say_native: Buyurtma berish uchun ikkita fe’l bor. “Uridu” — men istayman, “uḥibbu” — menga yaxshi ko‘raman. “Uridu qahwatan” — bitta qahva istayman. “Qahwatan” noaniq obyekt, oxiri “-an”. “Uḥibbu shurbatan mina al-qahwah” — bir cherek qahva. “Uridu” bilan obyekt “-an” bilan, “uḥibbu” bilan obyekt “-a” bilan keladi. Bu farqni unutmang.
scenes.say: Uridu means I want. Uhibbu means I like. Uridu qahwatan.
scenes.say_uz: Uridu men istayman. Uhibbu menga yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Istayman yoki yaxshi ko‘raman?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men choy istayman. Ikkinchi: menga qahva yaxshi. Uchinchi: men suv istayman. To‘rtinchi: menga sharbat yaxshi. “Uridu” va “uḥibbu” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: I want tea. I like coffee. I want water. I like juice.
scenes.say_uz: Men choy istayman. Meng qahva yaxshi. Men suv istayman. Menga sharbat yaxshi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: urīdu ash-shāya. Uḥibbu al-qahwata. Urīdu māʾan. Uḥibbu al-ʿaṣīra. Birinchi va uchinchida “urīdu”, oxiri “-an”. Ikkinchi va to‘rtinchida “uḥibbu”, oxiri “-a”. Har bir gapda obyekt to‘g‘ri shaklda. Endi kafeda buyurtma berishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: I want tea. I like coffee. I want water. I like juice.
scenes.say_uz: Men choy istayman. Meng qahva yaxshi. Men suv istayman. Menga sharbat yaxshi.

scenes.title: Kafeda buyurtma berish
board: أُرِيدُ قَهْوَةً بِالسُّكَّرِ — shakkar bilan qahva
scenes.say_native: Kafeda buyurtma berish: “urīdu qahwatan munfaqqan” — faqat qahva, “urīdu qahwatan bi al-sukkari” — shakkar bilan qahva, “urīdu qahwatan ḥāṣiratan” — issiq qahva, “urīdu shāyan bāridan” — sovun choy. “Bi” — bilan. Sifat so‘zi otga moslashadi: qahwah ḥāṣirah, shāʾ bārid. “Issiq” — “ḥārr”, “sovuq” — “bārid”. “Sukkar” bilan “bi al-sukkari” — shakkar bilan.
scenes.say: I want coffee only. Coffee with sugar. Hot coffee. Cold tea.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat qahva. Shakkar bilan qahva. Issiq qahva. Sovun choy.

scenes.title: Sifat moslamasligi
scenes.say_native: Yana ikkita xato. Birinchisi: qahva ayol jinsli, shuning uchun “ḥārratun”, “ḥārrun” emas: “qahwah ḥāṣirah”. Ikkinchisi: choy ham ayol jinsli, “shāʾ bārid” to‘g‘ri, chunki “shāʾ” erkak jinsli? Yo‘q, “shāʾ” erkak, shuning uchun “bāridun” to‘g‘ri. To‘g‘rilashtirilsin: “shāʾ bāridun” — sovun choy. Eslang: “qahwah” ayol, “shāʾ” erkak. Sifat jinsga mos bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Coffee is feminine, tea is masculine: qahwa ḥāṣirah, shāʾ bārid.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva ayol, shay erkak. Sifat jinsga mos bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Buyurtma bering
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men issiq qahva istayman. Ikkinchi: men sovun choy istayman. Uchinchi: menga panir yaxshi. To‘rtinchi: menga kartoshka yaxshi. Sifatlarni otga moslang.
scenes.say: I want hot coffee. I want cold tea. I like cheese. I like potatoes.
scenes.say_uz: Men issiq qahva istayman. Men sovun choy istayman. Meng panir yaxshi. Menga kartoshka yaxshi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: urīdu qahwatan ḥāṣiratan. Urīdu shāyan bāridan. Uḥibbu al-jubna. Uḥibbu al-biṭāṭisa. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchida “uḥibbu” va “al-” bor. “Al-biṭāṭisa” da “l” saqlanadi, chunki “b” oy harfi. Bu shakllarni yaxshi yodlab oling, keyingi dialogda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: I want hot coffee. I want cold tea. I like cheese. I like potatoes.
scenes.say_uz: Men issiq qahva istayman. Men sovun choy istayman. Meng panir yaxshi. Menga kartoshka yaxshi.

scenes.title: Narhni so‘rash
board: هَذَا بِخَمْسَةِ دَرَاهِمَ — bu besh so‘m
scenes.say_native: Narhni so‘rash: “kam ath-thamanu?” — narh qancha? Javob: “thamnu al-qahwah ʿasharatu dirhām” — qahva narhi on so‘m. “Hādhā bi khamsati dirhām” — bu besh so‘m. “Bi” — bilan, uchun. “Dirham” — valyuta nomi, “so‘m” ga o‘xshaydi. “ʿAshara” — on, “khamsah” — besh. Raqamlar keyinroq batafsil o‘rganiladi, hozircha ularni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Kam ath-thaman? How much is it? Thamnu al-qahwa ashara dirham.
scenes.say_uz: Narh qancha? Qahva narhi on so‘m. Bu besh so‘m.

scenes.title: Narhni ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: qahva narhi on so‘m. Ikkinchi: choy narhi besh so‘m. Uchinchi: sut narhi ikki so‘m. To‘rtinchi: non narhi bir so‘m. Raqamlarni ismiy shaklda aytang.
scenes.say: Coffee is ten som. Tea is five som. Milk is two som. Bread is one som.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva narhi on so‘m. Choy narhi besh so‘m. Sut narhi ikki so‘m. Non narhi bir so‘m.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: thamnu al-qahwah ʿasharatu dirhām. Thamnu ash-shāʾi khamsatu dirhām. Thamnu al-ḥalbi ithnāni dirhamayn. Thamnu al-khubzi dirham wāḥid. “Ithnāni dirhamayn” — ikkita so‘m, ikkilik shakl. “Dirham wāḥid” — bir so‘m. Bu shakllar iḍafa ichida. Endi kafeda dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Coffee is ten som. Tea is five som. Milk is two som. Bread is one som.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva narhi on so‘m. Choy narhi besh so‘m. Sut narhi ikki so‘m. Non narhi bir so‘m.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: kafeda
board: نَادِل: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا. مَا الَّذِي تُرِيدُ؟
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Nadir ahmo tushadi va “mā alladhī turīdu?” — nima istaysiz? Ahmad “urīdu qahwatan ḥāṣiratan munfaqqan” deb javob beradi: faqat issiq qahva. Nadir “wa mādhā maʿahā?” — u bilan nima? Ahmad “khubzan wa jubnan munfaqqan” — faqat non va panir. “Maʿahā” — u bilan, uning hamda. “Munfaqqan” — faqat, bir xil.
scenes.say: Welcome. What would you like? I want hot coffee only. What with it? Bread and cheese only.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Nima istaysiz? Men issiq qahva istayman, faqat. U bilan nima? Non va panir, faqat.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Ahmad nima istaydi? Ikkinchi: qahva qanday? Uchinchi: nima bilan? To‘rtinchi: faqatmi? Dialogdan javob bering.
scenes.say: What does Ahmad want? What kind of coffee? With what? Only?
scenes.say_uz: Ahmad nima istaydi? Qahva qanday? Nima bilan? Faqatmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Ahmad qahwatan ḥāṣiratan istaydi. Qahva issiq. U bilan non va panir. Ha, faqat. “Munfaqqan” — faqat, boshqa narsa yo‘q. Bu so‘z kafeda buyurtma berishda juda foydali. Endi ikkinchi dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Hot coffee. Hot. Bread and cheese. Yes, only.
scenes.say_uz: Issiq qahva. Issiq. Non va panir. Ha, faqat.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: to‘liq ovqat
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sara nonushtani istaydi. Nadir nonushtada nima borligini so‘raydi. Sara non, panir, tuxum va choy deb javob beradi. Narh besh so‘m. Sara “hādhā jayyid” — bu yaxshi, “hāk al-fulūs” — pulni oling. “Al-fulūs” — pul. “Jayyid” — yaxshi. Buyurtma va to‘lash bir borada.
scenes.say: I want breakfast only. What is in the breakfast? Bread, cheese, eggs and tea. The price is five som. This is good. Here is the money.
scenes.say_uz: Men nonushta istayman, faqat. Nonushtada nima bor? Non, panir, tuxum va choy. Narh besh so‘m. Bu yaxshi. Oling pulni.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Sara nima istaydi? Ikkinchi: nonushtada nima bor? Uchinchi: narh qancha? To‘rtinchi: u nima deyadi? Dialogdan javob bering.
scenes.say: What does Sara want? What is in the breakfast? How much is it? What does she say?
scenes.say_uz: Sara nima istaydi? Nonushtada nima bor? Narh qancha? U nima deyadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Sara al-faṭūra istaydi. Nonushtada khubz, jubn, bayḍ, shāʾ bor. Narh khamsatu dirhām. Sara “hādhā jayyid” va “hāk al-fulūs” dedi. “Hāk al-fulūs” — pulni oling. Bu to‘liq buyurtma va to‘lash jarayoni. Endi o‘zingiz buyurtma berasiz.
scenes.say: Breakfast. Bread, cheese, eggs and tea. Five som. This is good. Here is the money.
scenes.say_uz: Nonushta. Non, panir, tuxum, choy. Besh so‘m. Bu yaxshi. Oling pulni.

scenes.title: Kafeda buyurtma bering
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men qahva istayman. Ikkinchi: menga choy yaxshi. Uchinchi: narh qancha? To‘rtinchi: oling pulni. Buyurtma beruvchi bo‘lib gapiring. “Uridu” va “uḥibbu” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: I want coffee. I like tea. How much is it? Here is the money.
scenes.say_uz: Men qahva istayman. Meng choy yaxshi. Narh qancha? Oling pulni.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: urīdu qahwatan. Uḥibbu ash-shāya. Kam ath-thamanu? Hāk al-fulūs. “Uridu” bilan obyekt “-an”, “uḥibbu” bilan obyekt “-a”. “Hāk al-fulūs” to‘lash jarayonida. Agar hamma gapni to‘g‘ri aytsangiz, kafeda buyurtma berishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: I want coffee. I like tea. How much is it? Here is the money.
scenes.say_uz: Men qahva istayman. Meng choy yaxshi. Narh qancha? Oling pulni.

scenes.title: Mahsulot turini ajratish
scenes.say_native: Mahsulot turlarini ajratamiz. “Al-faṭūr” — nonushta, “al-ʿashāʾ” — kechki ovqat, “al-ghadāʾ” — tushlik. “Pul” — “al-fulūs”. “Ḥalb” — sut ot, “aḥlaba” — sut chiqardi (fe’l). Bu ikki so‘zni aralashtirmang. “Al-ṭaʿām” — ovqat umuman. Kafeda “al-faṭūr” eng ko‘p ishlatiladi. Endi o‘z ovqat va ichimlikingizni nomlang.
scenes.say: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, food, money.
scenes.say_uz: Nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat, ovqat, pul.

scenes.title: Ovqatni nomlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta so‘zni arabcha ayting: nonushta, kechki ovqat, ovqat, pul. “Al-faṭūr”, “al-ʿashāʾ”, “al-ṭaʿām”, “al-fulūs”. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say: breakfast, dinner, food, money.
scenes.say_uz: Ayting: nonushta, kechki ovqat, ovqat, pul.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: al-faṭūr, al-ʿashāʾ, al-ṭaʿām, al-fulūs. “Al-ṭaʿām” da “ṭ” quyosh harfi, shuning uchun “al-ṭaʿām” emas, “aṭ-ṭaʿām” deymiz. “Al-fulūs” da “l” saqlanadi, chunki “f” oy harfi. Bu talaffuz xususiyatlarini eslab qoling. Endi yakuniy mashqga o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: Breakfast, dinner, food, money.
scenes.say_uz: Nonushta, kechki ovqat, ovqat, pul.

scenes.title: 5 mahsulot nomlang
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Kafedagi 5 mahsulotni nomlang va ularning narhini aytang. Kamida ikkita ichimlik va ikkita ovqat bo‘lsin. “Thamnuhu …” — uning narhi … degani. Buyurtma beruvchi va sotuvchi bo‘lib gapiring.
scenes.say: Name five products and their prices.
scenes.say_uz: Besh mahsulotni nomlang va narhini aytang.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini tekshirish
scenes.say_native: Tekshiring. Birinchi: buyurtma gapida “urīdu” yoki “uḥibbu” bormi? Ikkinchi: sifat otga moslashganmi? Uchinchi: narh berilganmi? To‘rtinchi: beshta mahsulot nomlanganmi? Har biriga “ha” desangiz, vazifa bajarildi.
scenes.say: Check uridu, adjective agreement, price and five products.
scenes.say_uz: “Uridu”, sifat mosligi, narh va beshta mahsulotni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Buyurtma berishda adabiyot
scenes.say_native: Kafeda adabiy bo‘lish juda muhim. “Min faḍlika” — iltimos, erkakka aytiladi. “Min faḍhliki” — iltimos, ayolga aytiladi. “Shukran” — rahmat. “Afwan” — xush kelibsiz yoki rica eting, bu sotuvchi javobi. “Min faḍlika, urīdu qahwatan” — iltimos, bitta qahva olaman. O‘zbek tilida “iltimos” har ikkalaga bir xil, arabchada esa suhbatdoshning jinsiga qarab “faḍlika” va “faḍhliki” bo‘linadi. Shukran deb aytganda sotuvchi “afwan” deb javob beradi. Bu oddiy so‘zlar suhbatni nozik va mehribon qiladi.
scenes.say: Min fadlika means please to a man, min fadhliki to a woman. Shukran is thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Min fadlika erkakka iltimos, min fadhliki ayolga. Shukran rahmat.

scenes.title: Adabiy dialog: kafeda
scenes.say_native: Adabiy dialog. Mushtori: “Min faḍlika, urīdu qahwatan” — iltimos, bitta qahva olaman. Sotuvchi: “Shukran” — rahmat. Mushtori yana: “Shukran” — rahmat. Sotuvchi: “Afwan” — xush kelibsiz. Ikkala tomonda ham “iltimos” va “rahmat” ishlatildi. Bu kafeda buyurtma berishning adabiy shakli. O‘zbek tilida ham “iltimos” va “rahmat” buyurtma bermoqda zarur.
scenes.say: Please, I would like coffee. Thank you. You are welcome.
scenes.say_uz: Iltimos, bitta qahva olaman. Rahmat. Xush kelibsiz.

scenes.title: Iltimos va rahmat
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: erkakka murojaat qilib, iltimos, bitta qahva olaman. Ikkinchi: rahmat. Uchinchi: ayolga murojaat qilib, iltimos, bitta choy olaman. To‘rtinchi: sotuvchi javobi, xush kelibsiz. “Min faḍlika” va “min faḍhliki” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: Please, I would like coffee. Thank you. Please, I would like tea. You are welcome.
scenes.say_uz: Iltimos, bitta qahva olaman. Rahmat. Iltimos, bitta choy olaman. Xush kelibsiz.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: hamza va shadda
scenes.say_native: Qahvada hamza harfi bor, uni qafdan keyin aniq ayting: qah-vah. “Shukran” da “k” shadda bilan: shuk-ran, k ikki marta eshitiladi. “Min faḍlika” bo‘g‘inlarga ajratilsin: min-fad-li-ka. “Ḥalb” da “l” oddiy, “b” oxirida. Bu so‘zlarni baland ovozda takrorlang, har bir unli aniq bo‘lsin. Hamza arab tilining xusus harfi, uni o‘tkazib yubormang.
scenes.say: Qah-va, shuk-ran, min-fad-li-ka. Say the hamza and shadda clearly.
scenes.say_uz: Qah-va, shuk-ran, min-fad-li-ka. Hamza va shaddani aniq ayting.

scenes.title: Baland ovozda o‘qing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta iborani baland ovozda o‘qing. Birinchi: iltimos, bitta qahva olaman. Ikkinchi: rahmat. Uchinchi: bitta choy olaman. To‘rtinchi: narh qancha? Har birini ikki marta takrorlang, hamza va shaddaga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Read aloud: please, coffee. Thank you. I would like tea. How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: Baland o‘qing: iltimos, qahva. Rahmat. Choy olaman. Narh qancha?

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Ichimlik va ovqat nomlarini o‘rgandik: qahvah, shāʾ, māʾ, khubz, jubn, laḥm. Buyurtma berish: “urīdu” va “uḥibbu”. Obyekt “urīdu” da “-an”, “uḥibbu” da “-a”. Narh: “kam ath-thamanu?”. “Munfaqqan” — faqat, “bi al-sukkari” — shakkar bilan. Eng muhim fikr: jins va kelishik qoidalar bo‘ladi, shuning uchun sifatlarni moslang.
scenes.say: Food and drink, ordering with uridu and uhibbu, prices and only.
scenes.say_uz: Ichimlik va ovqat, “uridu” va “uhibbu” bilan buyurtma, narh va faqat.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Kafeda buyurtma beruvchi dialog yozing va tarjima qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida ikkita ichimlik, ikkita ovqat, to‘g‘ri narh va to‘lash. Keyingi darsda uy, xonalar va jihozlarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: write a café ordering dialogue.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: kafeda buyurtma beruvchi dialog yozing.

homework_uz: Kafeda buyurtma beruvchi dialog yozing va tarjima qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida ikkita ichimlik, ikkita ovqat, to‘g‘ri narh va to‘lash.
